figurative_meaning_en: Instigating conflict by carrying complaints or slander from one person to another
similar_in_english: Playing both ends against the middle
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দুই ভাইয়ের মধ্যে লাগালাগি করে তাদের সম্পর্ক নষ্ট করে দিল।
পাড়ায় লাগালাগির জন্য অনেক ঝগড়া হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He ruined the relationship between the two brothers by engaging in lagalagi.
Many quarrels happen in the neighborhood due to tale-carrying.
note: This idiom reflects common social behaviors in Bengali communities where gossip can escalate minor issues.
